questions.solution: Given: **27 September 2001** was Thursday. Now, 2001 to 2009 = 8 Years (6 Ordinary Years and 2 Leap Years). And, In 8 Years = 2 Leap years and 6 Ordinary Years. So, 2 Leap Years have 4 odd days, And, 6 Ordinary Years have 6 odd days. Total odd days = 4 + 6 = 10.

questions.question:
Three statements are followed by conclusions numbered I, II. You have to consider these statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts. Decide which of the given conclusions logically follow/s from the given statement.

**Statements:**

Some leaves are trees.

All stones are grain.

Some grains are leaves.

**Conclusion (I):** All grains are trees.

**Conclusion (II):** Some leaves are stones.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21243ff04cf2d2f471ae833c1f5bab2680a135e05f6c44417fca39de8d25d97a.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All grains are trees → **Does not** follow (As some leaves are trees and some grains are leaves. So it is possible but not definite.)

II. Some leaves are stones → Does not follow (As all stones are grain and some grains are leaves. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"

questions.question:
In a certain code language,

‘M & N’ means ‘M is the wife of N’,

‘M @ N’ means ‘M is the son of N’,

‘M $ N’ means ‘M is the mother of N’.

Based on the above, how is R related to O if ‘N $ O @ P @ Q & R’?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Decoding symbols:

Given: N $ O @ P @ Q & R

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f63da512a6ecaaa8d9077a62a5aba2008a616cf454151937dff10c9ef67122ba.png]

Thus, R is O's parental grandfather or father's father.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question: If 17 December 2012 was Monday, then what was the day of the week on 18 November 2020?
questions.solution:
Given: **17 December 2012** was Monday.

Now,

2012 to 2020 = 8 Years (6 Ordinary Years and 2 Leap Years).

And, In 8 Years = 2 Leap Years and 6 Ordinary Years.

So, 2 Leap Years have 4 odd days,

And, 6 Ordinary Years have 6 odd days.

Total odd days = 4 + 6 = 10.

10 odd days → 10/7 = 1 week and 3 odd days.

then, 17 December 2020 will be Monday + 3 = Thursday.

Now, the number of days between 18 November 2020 to 17 December 2020

= 12 + 17 = 29 days.

= 29 days → 29/7 = 4 weeks and 1 odd days.

The dates are in past, so subtract 1 days from the day on 17 December 2020 which is Thursday

So, **18 November 2020** will be Thursday - 1 = Wednesday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

Now,

For, (26, 29, 165)

⇒ (26 + 29) × 3 = 55 × 3 = 165.

Similarly, for **(23, 26, 147)**

**⇒ (23 + 26) × 3 = 49 × 3 = 147.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
